name: The Visit from a Winter Breeze
source:
After a sleepwalking episode leads her onto the street, Santas Altria finds something unexpected in a dumpster: a frightened demi-human girl with nowhere to go.

She brings her home, tends to her, and gives her a name:

Djanny.

What follows are careful days and the uneasy feeling that something isn’t being said. 

As fragments of the past begin to surface, Santas is forced to confront her past.

[From [url=https://roundercover.itch.io/the-visit-from-a-winter-breeze]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
梦游事件让桑塔斯·阿尔特里亚走上街头，她在垃圾箱里发现了一些意想不到的东西：一个受惊的亚人女孩，无处可去。

她把她带回家，照顾她，并给她起了一个名字：

贾尼.

接下来是小心翼翼的日子，以及因没有说出某些话而感到不安的感觉。

随着过去的碎片开始浮出水面，圣诞老人被迫面对她的过去。

[来自[url=https://roundercover.itch.io/the-visit-from-a-winter-breeze]itch.io[/url]]
